increment: BDREditor-01-Table (local proposal; no official F9 task number assigned)

constraints.header: if true, first row renders as thead/th scope=col; remaining rows render in tbody

editing.insert_default: 3 rows x 3 columns with a header row
editing.history: each table structure action is one editor undo/redo commit
editing.responsive: bounded horizontal scrolling; no document-controlled CSS

rendering.cell_text: fixed allowlisted inline tags and contextual escaping from shared rich text renderer

compatibility.v1: preserved unchanged; table rejected unless document format_version is 2
compatibility.save_flow: existing explicit form POST only; no autosave

verification_scope: static JavaScript syntax, fixture parsing and client validator checks only; no PHP/browser/app/SQL runtime
